summary: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence in Abu Dhabi offers fully funded M.Sc. and Ph.D. programmes in artificial intelligence. International students receive free tuition, a monthly stipend, a yearly flight home and health insurance. Most applications for fall 2027 close on 15 December 2026.
meta_title: MBZUAI funded master's and PhD in AI: fall 2027 deadline
meta_description: MBZUAI in Abu Dhabi funds M.Sc. and Ph.D. students in AI with free tuition and a monthly stipend of AED 15,500 or 17,500. Apply by 15 December 2026.
covers: Free tuition on the M.Sc. and Ph.D. programmes.
A monthly stipend for international students: AED 15,500 for the M.Sc., AED 17,500 for the Ph.D.
One return flight home each year.
Health insurance for the approved funding period, and a university-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible.
eligibility: MBZUAI accepts students of all nationalities.
A degree in a STEM field such as computer science, electrical or computer engineering, mathematics or physics, from an accredited institution.
A CGPA of at least 3.0 or 3.5 out of 4.0, depending on the programme.
Final-year students can apply with a transcript and show the full degree after admission.
how_to_apply: Choose one programme: only one application per admission cycle is processed.
Apply through the MBZUAI portal, which opened on 7 September 2026, or 30 September for Computational Biology.
Take the screening exam, then pay the AED 200 application fee.

Submit by 5 p.m. Gulf time on 15 December 2026, or 22 January 2027 for Computational Biology. Shortlisted applicants have a technical interview. Decisions come by 31 March 2027, and you reply by 15 April.
watch_out: The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence is fee-based, at AED 170,000 in total, and carries no funding. Its deadline is 28 February 2027.
A Ph.D. is centrally funded in year 1. Funding then moves to your faculty advisor, so it depends on a confirmed advisor match by the end of that year and on satisfactory progress.
You are expected to stay in person on campus during the funded period and get approval before being away.
An outside scholarship normally replaces the MBZUAI stipend rather than adding to it, and you must disclose it.
costs: Tuition on the M.Sc. and Ph.D.
One return flight a year, health insurance

faq.q: Can international students study at MBZUAI for free?
faq.a: Yes, on the M.Sc. and Ph.D. programmes, which MBZUAI describes as fully funded, with free tuition and a monthly stipend. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence charges fees.

faq.q: When is the MBZUAI deadline for fall 2027?
faq.a: 15 December 2026 at 5 p.m. Gulf time for most graduate programmes, and 22 January 2027 for Computational Biology.

faq.q: How much is the MBZUAI stipend?
faq.a: For international students, AED 15,500 a month on the M.Sc. and AED 17,500 a month on the Ph.D.
